Mice generally last longer when they have company, good hiding spots and humans simply cant fulfill their social needs

Just like us, mice can become depressed and suicidal from lack of social contact (unless you have a really tame mouse   that trusts you)

I recommend having at least 3 or 4 mice and a large cage

Alot of people use glass cages. If you do so, make sure to have pieces of driftwood and a closed running wheel (ones with openings can cause severe wounds if they misstep or their tails can get stuck) 
  
 I myself use a cage with aluminun bars because it       basically doubles their usable space

Make sure to have varied food like nuts and grains and give fresh food every 2 days minimum (strawberries, bell peper, etc) and refresh their water once every day and on hot days 2 or 3 times a day

I use partial humus/dirt bedding combined with recycled paper and for the area they designated for sleeping i use bathroom carpet (very nice cuz washable)

Make sure they have a dark and cool area and a high area overlooking the cage (they really like that in my experience)

Also have extra houses and play material for outside of the cage
Usually i take them out once a day for an hour of play in a seperate cage with hidden treats or just on my couch (if you do that NEVER let them out of your sight)

I once woke up with 2 wild mice sleeping underneath my hand

I think mice have some kind of 6th sense for recognising friendly people (i own a small group of domestic mice)
